objective: Gate 12H readiness previa a ejecutar la migracion ya certificada de Gate 12G. Auditar exclusivamente metadata SQL actual para confirmar que dbo.CavaSocios_Socios.PersonaID sigue ausente, que dbo.Gobierno_Persona.PersonaID sigue siendo bigint PK, que no existe FK o indice previo/conflictivo para PersonaID, que las tres FK operativas Botellas/Cargos/Movimientos siguen intactas por SocioID y que la poblacion de socios permanece agregadamente identificada. NO ejecutar DDL/DML, NO crear otra migracion y NO realizar backfill. Este Gate solo decide READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_DEVELOPMENT_MIGRATION o BLOCKED segun evidencia fisica.

queries.name: gate12h_r4_personaid_absent
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS personaid_columns FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND name=N'PersonaID'

queries.name: gate12h_r4_persona_pk
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') AND i.is_primary_key=1 ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate12h_r4_existing_persona_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND (pc.name=N'PersonaID' OR fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona')) ORDER BY fk.name

queries.name: gate12h_r4_existing_persona_index
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,i.is_unique,i.is_disabled,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND (i.name=N'IX_CavaSocios_Socios_PersonaID' OR c.name=N'PersonaID') AND i.is_hypothetical=0 ORDER BY i.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate12h_r4_children_fk_preserved
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,pc.name AS child_column,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS parent_table,rc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') ORDER BY child_table,fk.name

queries.name: gate12h_r4_socios_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
